_note: Shot lists for the film case pages ('In this shot'). Timecodes in seconds from research/content/films-audit.md. Shots with real faces, end cards, overlay supers, archive-looking footage or real driver names are left out. 'built' lines describe what is on screen and are placeholders until Adil confirms what DISRUPT made on each film (CONFIRM WITH ADIL). 'at' (optional) overrides the frame-grab time (default: the shot's mid timecode). scripts/media/build-case-media.mjs reads this file to grab one frame per shot.
